description: tela is a markdown-native team wiki where AI agents are first-class participants. Connect ChatGPT to your team's knowledge base to read, write, and maintain docs at scale. • Semantic search ("research") — answer questions by meaning, returning assembled grounding from full page bodies with flagged source disagreements • Keyword search — ranked, snippet-highlighted full-text lookup • Authoring — create, update, and surgically patch pages; move, delete, share with public links • Knowledge health — surface near-duplicate pages, identify unanswered questions, suggest links • Atlas — auto-generate technical docs from git repos and Jira; trigger re-ingestion, poll coverage • Presentations — author, lint, and preview Slidev slide decks stored as wiki pages. Connect by signing in with your tela account. Self-host via docker compose (AGPL) or use telawiki.com.
